_comment: Localized marketing-screenshot captions. Keyed <target>/<basename>, matching the raw capture PNG names. Each entry is the headline and subtitle overlaid on the framed store shot by tool/compose_marketing.dart. Keep headlines short (they set at a large size) and honour the App Store Guideline 2.3.10 rule: no other-platform names in app/* captions.
